name: Bartosz Cho
role: Counter-surveillance and mole detection — counterintelligence specialist
location: Geartown — industrial district of chop shops and fabricators, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Bartosz Cho is lean and angular, all sharp edges and visible tension. At 29, scars map her face like a transit diagram of bad decisions and worse luck. The chrome is visible — reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She came up through the Gray Zone's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see her surpass them. She works as a counterintelligence specialist out of Geartown, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Bartosz Cho has built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — she shows up, she delivers, she collects.

core_fears: Their past catching up — debts, enemies, broken promises
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
core_desires: Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
coping_mechanisms: Compartmentalization — work feelings and personal feelings exist in separate boxes
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Speaks in clipped fragments when stressed — drops pronouns, articles, pleasantries
Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
example_lines: "Everyone in this room is lying. My job is knowing who's lying about what."
"Paranoia isn't a disorder in this profession. It's a job requirement."
"I find the leak. What happens to the leak after that isn't my department."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Arseniy Granlund-Tawiah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A corporate black site Arseniy Granlund-Tawiah once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know her face
Arseniy Granlund-Tawiah's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Arseniy Granlund-Tawiah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Reflex boosters wired into spinal column — shaves reaction time by 40ms. Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Freelance — works the Gray Zone circuit exclusively

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness
augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly South Asian (49%) with substantial East Asian (37.2%) and Southeast Asian (13.8%) ancestry. This genetic combination produces warm medium-to-deep brown skin with golden and honey undertones characteristic of South Asian heritage, refined by the sharp angular features and high prominent cheekbones from East Asian genetics. The Southeast Asian component contributes refined bone structure, subtle warmth depth, and the integrated aesthetic that bridges the other ancestries seamlessly.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible musculature — low body fat, wiry frame built for speed and endurance rather than strength. Shoulders slightly asymmetrical from old injury or chronic tension.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with early-stage silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid — no ornamentation
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with pale grey-blue rim and faint stress lines radiating outward — unusual dual-tone coloration suggesting genetic complexity or subtle cybernetic enhancement
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden and honey undertones — South Asian base harmoniously blended with East and Southeast Asian heritage creating rich, unified depth across face and body
physical_description.complexion: Weathered for her age. High, prominent cheekbones with sharp, refined facial planes characteristic of the South and East Asian genetic blend. Extensive scarring across left cheekbone (three parallel lines, old blade work), smaller scar tissue along right temple (impact), faint burn mark along jawline. Minimal makeup, meticulous grooming despite working lifestyle.
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel blade scars running diagonally across left cheekbone, approximately 8cm total length, white and well-healed
Impact scar on right temple just above hairline, crescent-shaped, approximately 2cm, silvered tissue
Burn scar along right jawline below ear, faint and thin, approximately 4cm in length
Thin white scar running along inside of left wrist — longitudinal, approximately 6cm, surgical precision
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome reflex booster hardware visible along spine — brushed steel nodes running from mid-thoracic to sacrum, approximately 2cm diameter, interconnected with faint luminescent tracery when active. Fingertips show faint geometric patterning under skin (gecko-grip implant ports) visible only in certain light. No attempt to conceal augmentation work.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise — minimal wasted motion. Walks with weight on balls of feet, ready to shift direction. Sits with back to wall and clear sightlines. Hands rest within 15cm of body. Eyes track movement constantly. Overall impression: coiled spring.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian — function over aesthetics. Dark textiles (charcoal, black, deep blue) in durable synthetics and treated canvas. Reinforced cargo pants with custom thigh holster rig. Fitted tactical jacket (matte black, multiple pockets, cable management built in). Worn Geartown-manufacture climbing boots with custom grip soles. No logos or visible branding. Jewelry: only a scratched chronometer on left wrist, military-grade, probably scavenged. Overall aesthetic: prepared for immediate action, zero flash.
